items.statement: Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume, including the explicit rank-zero extension. Let V:E→ℝ be C², 0<α≤β, and assume α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v. Assume η>0 and βη≤1. Define μ(dx) proportional to exp(−V(x))dx, J as the law of (X,X+√η Z) for independent X~μ and Z~N(0,I), ν=J.snd, and Λ as the law of (Y,2X−Y) under J. These are probability laws. Put mY=comap(snd), H_P=L² classes measurable with respect to mY, P=i∘E[·|Y] and the canonical M:u↦u∘snd. Then H_P=ran(P), P is identity on H_P, and there exists an onto linear isometry e:L²(ν;ℝ)≃H_P with i e=M. There is a Markov kernel S whose every-state normalized law is S(y)=volume.tilted(x↦−V((y+x)/2)−‖y−x‖²/(8η)); Λ.IsCondKernel S and both Λ marginals equal ν. The same joint reflection F(x,y)=(x,2x−y) gives the involutive selfadjoint isometry U, with Uf=f∘F J-almost everywhere for every f. There is a bounded selfadjoint T on the full real L²(ν), with ‖Tu‖≤‖u‖, Tu(y)=∫u(x)S(y,dx) ν-almost everywhere for each u, and preserved integral. On H_P put A=PUP restricted via i and orthogonal projection, and B=(I_J−P)UPi:H_P→L²(J). Then A=eTe⁻¹ is selfadjoint and contractive, PB=0. There is a bounded positive operator Γ on the real scalar-valued L² space with Γ²=I−T². For the SAME transported Γ_P=eΓe⁻¹, positivity holds and Γ_P²=I_H_P−A²=B*B. There is q∈L²(ν;ℝ) equal to one ν-almost everywhere, with Tq=q and ⟨q,u⟩=∫u dν for every u. Set q_P=e q and H_P^0=ker⟨q_P,·⟩, with its inherited Hilbert structure. Membership is exactly zero ν-mean after e⁻¹. The SAME Γ_P annihilates q_P. Put γ=2√(αη)/(1+αη)>0. There exists Γ_0:H_P^0→H_P^0 equal under inclusion to the restriction of Γ_P, positive with Γ_0−γ I positive. Γ_0 is a unit in the algebra of bounded real operators. There exists a bounded real Inv on this SAME centered space with Inv Γ_0=Γ_0 Inv=I and ‖Inv‖≤1/γ. All probability, normalization, range, root, centering, spectral-gap, unit and inverse facts are internally derived from the original inputs; none is an additional public premise. αη=1 and rank-zero E remain legal. No inverse on full H_P is asserted. Define the actual closed conditional-mean-zero space H_perp=ker P in L²(J;ℝ), with its inherited complete Hilbert structure; this is not merely the globally zero-mean joint space. There exists B_0:H_P^0→H_perp whose inclusion equals B i_0. There exists V_0:H_P^0→H_perp with V_0=B_0 Inv, B_0=V_0 Γ_0, V_0* V_0=I and ‖V_0 f‖=‖f‖ for every f∈H_P^0. All these objects and identities are conclusions from the same original inputs. There exists the canonical bounded residual map R:L²(J;ℝ)→H_perp with i_perp Rg=g−Pg for every joint g. The SAME ambient adjoint satisfies B* g=i_0 B_0* Rg for every joint g; the printed intrinsic block adjoint is recovered on H_perp. For every actual joint f∈L²(J;ℝ) with ∫f dJ=0, there exists f_P∈H_P^0 whose inclusion is E[f|Y]. Put f_perp=Rf and f_V=V_0* f_perp∈the SAME H_P^0. Then B* i_perp f_perp=i_0 Γ_0 f_V=Γ_P i_0 f_V, ‖f‖²=‖f_P‖²+‖f_perp‖² and ‖f_V‖≤‖f_perp‖. The global zero-mean condition is a quantified input restriction to this concluded implication, not an extra assumption on the potential or an operator certificate. The SAME root commutes with T and its transport commutes with A. The SAME Inv on H_P^0 is selfadjoint. There exists an internally constructed A_0:H_P^0→H_P^0 whose inclusion equals A after inclusion; it is selfadjoint,commutes with Γ_0,satisfies A_0²+Γ_0²=I,and commutes with the SAME Inv. Define D=R U i_perp:H_perp→H_perp using the SAME produced U,R and the inclusion i_perp. For every h∈H_perp, i_perp D h=U i_perp h−P(U i_perp h). On ALL of H_perp the SAME actual polar adjoint satisfies V_0* D=−A_0 V_0*. This identity is not restricted to the range of V_0; no surjectivity or coisometry is assumed. Every preceding actual law/kernel/root/inverse/polar/ambient-adjoint and globally centered-observable conclusion persists with the same witnesses. The reflection is fixed by its almost-everywhere pullback formula; the already compiled actual reflection block identity is transported only after proving equality of that reflection with the current U. This is the full micro-space intertwining ingredient used in Appendix B.3 (B.21) and Lemma B.4. The actual projected rotation and corrector change, weak H1/B2, B4 dynamics, invariance/nonexplosion, main convergence, implementation errors/caps, expected query costs and actual-input composition remain separate. One private literal Prop stores the complete sealed proposition and supplies no mathematical proof provider or additional premise.
assumptions: Finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel base E with canonical volume, including the disclosed rank-zero extension; V is C²; 0<α≤β; both global Hessian bounds; η>0 and βη≤1.

Canonical normalized laws/kernel, onto pullback e, SAME U/T, full and centered roots, exact centering, gap, unit and bounded inverse are conclusions. Conditional actions are per-observable AE. L² is not assumed finite-dimensional.
γ=2√(αη)/(1+αη); the inverse acts only on H_P^0=ker⟨e1,·⟩ with inherited Hilbert structure; the legal endpoint αη=1 is retained.

H_perp is exactly ker P (conditional expectation given Y), while H_P^0 is the zero ν-mean macroscopic space. Their complete Hilbert structures, B_0 and V_0 are internally constructed; no onto-kerP or coisometry assumption is introduced.

The concluded global-input implication quantifies every f∈L²(J) with integral zero. R,conditional centering,constant annihilation,adjoint range and norm decomposition are derived internally. Private statement definitions expand literally to the original sealed propositions and add no premise.
D=R U inclusion and V0*D=-A0V0* on all ker P are internally proved conclusions, not source hypotheses. No onto-V0, sharp-energy estimate or additional smoothness is required.
